Affordable Homes in Northern Colorado: What’s Available Under $400K?

Home prices in Northern Colorado have risen in recent years, making it harder for buyers to find affordable options. However, homes under $400K are still available—if you know where to look.

Where Can You Find Homes Under $400K?

  • Greeley & Evans – Affordable single-family homes and townhomes.
  • Wellington & Windsor – Townhomes and paired homes.
  • Loveland & Fort Collins – Primarily condos and townhomes.
  • Johnstown, Milliken & Severance – New construction townhomes.
  • Berthoud & Eaton – Fixer-uppers and rural properties.

What Type of Homes Can You Get for $400K?

  • Townhomes & Condos – Low maintenance and newer construction.
  • Older Single-Family Homes – Available in select areas.
  • New Construction Townhomes – Found in growing communities.
  • Fixer-Uppers – Great for buyers willing to renovate.

Why Homes Under $400K Sell Fast

  • Strong Buyer Demand – First-time buyers and investors compete.
  • Limited Inventory – Fewer homes are available.
  • Investors Target Affordable Homes – Great for rental income.

How to Compete in This Market

  • Get Pre-Approved First – Sellers prefer pre-approved buyers.
  • Act Quickly – Homes in this range sell fast.
  • Consider Townhomes & Condos – More availability in this price range.
  • Work With a Local Agent – Get early access to listings.
Start Your Home Search

Buyer Assistance Programs

  • CHFA – Low-interest loans & down payment assistance.
  • First-Time Buyer Grants – Cash grants for eligible buyers.
  • USDA Loans – Zero-down options for rural areas.
  • FHA Loans – As little as 3.5% down.
